title: Decision tree query trace
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose queries use coordinates from a finite set, and let $x$ assign an alphabet symbol to each coordinate. The query trace of $T$ on $x$ is the ordered list of coordinates queried along the path determined by $x$; it is empty at a leaf.
hypotheses_covered: Finite decision tree over coordinate set $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and alphabet $Ω$
